up: Retrieve the distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3881481. For each molecule, output its ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), and canonical SMILES. Use the document identifier from the docs table. If a molecule does not have a canonical SMILES, still include it with NULL for that column.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id,
       md.pref_name,
       cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3881481';
